summary: Comprehensive testing of Multi-Company SP ERP - Company scoping and data isolation fixes. Backend: 28/28 tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All director and manager pages verified. Key fix validated: Director sees All Companies with aggregated data (P&L ₹3,25,625), Manager sees only FL Shop with scoped data (P&L ₹2,600).

issues: WebSocket connection fails but app continues to work - non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: Company scoping working correctly - Director defaults to 'All Companies', Manager defaults to assigned company
Data isolation verified: Director P&L ₹3,25,625 vs Manager P&L ₹2,600
Manager nav correctly hides director-only items (Daily Summary, Executive, Companies, Users, Roles, Reconciliation)
resolve_company_id function properly auto-scopes non-directors to their assigned company
All CRUD endpoints (tasks, reports, indents, transactions, journal-entries) correctly use company_id filtering
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Manager_Entry_Scoping_Test journal entry during testing

Manager correctly cannot access director-only pages (Daily Summary, Executive, Companies, Users, Roles, Reconciliation). All pages load correctly for both roles.
